CSEQ original-sample playback and resource parsing

TypeScript adaptations of the self-contained Nintendo 3DS implementation in
DualRip by Tetra_Sky, with source-backed wave reads and browser integration.
https://github.com/TetraSsky/DualRip
Pinned reference: f69e23c63a7d0985a474d0cbaeb2b364174748ac

The adapted parser, command grammar, driver math, numeric tables and mixer
retain the following license. No Nintendo sound data or firmware is bundled.
